LEGAL_PRIVACY_USAGE_DEVICE_HEADING: Información de uso y del dispositivo
LEGAL_PRIVACY_USAGE_DEVICE_BODY: When you access the Platform, we collect limited technical data such as browser type, device information, time zone, and interaction events (for example, uploads and errors). Your IP address is used only in the moment to rate-limit requests and prevent abuse; we do not store it in raw form. We also derive a hashed fingerprint from your browser to detect abuse. This helps us secure the service and improve performance.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_CONNECTED_ACCOUNT_HEADING: Signing In with a Connected Account
LEGAL_PRIVACY_CONNECTED_ACCOUNT_INTRO: You can sign in with a magic link or by connecting a third-party account. When you sign in with a connected account, we receive only the information needed to create or identify your Snipp account:
LEGAL_PRIVACY_CONNECTED_DISCORD_TEXT: Your Discord account ID, email address, and basic profile details.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_CONNECTED_GOOGLE_TEXT: Your Google account ID and email address.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_CONNECTED_GITHUB_TEXT: Your GitHub account ID, username, and email address.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_CONNECTED_X_TEXT: Your X account ID and username, and your email address if you have granted access to it.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_CONNECTED_ACCOUNT_OUTRO: We use this information only to create your account, sign you in, and suggest a username. We do not import or re-host your avatar or other profile media, and we do not post on your behalf. You can disconnect a linked account at any time in your settings.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_UPLOADS_STORAGE_P1: Uploaded files are stored in {r2}. All files are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM encryption. Files are transmitted over HTTPS. Each file is associated with your user ID in metadata for access control and ownership verification. Internal access is restricted to authorized personnel for operational needs only.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_UPLOADS_STORAGE_VIDEO: Video uploads may additionally be processed and delivered through {stream} to enable adaptive streaming playback. A copy of the original file remains in our primary storage, and the same encryption and access controls apply.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_UPLOADS_STORAGE_P2: Puede eliminar sus subidas en cualquier momento. Cuando elimina un archivo, este se retira de inmediato de nuestros sistemas de almacenamiento y de la caché de nuestra CDN. Cualquier copia restante que aparezca tras la eliminación es resultado de la caché de su propio dispositivo o navegador, que no podemos controlar.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_CONTENT_RESPONSIBILITY_BOD: Uploaded media and text are checked by an automated safety classifier, and content may also be reviewed after a report. You are solely responsible for the content you share. Content that is unlawful, infringes intellectual property rights, or poses risks to others may be removed if reported or required by law, in accordance with our Terms of Service. We will respond to valid copyright infringement notices in accordance with applicable law. Contact {email}.

LEGAL_PRIVACY_HOW_WE_USE_ITEM_AUTHENTICA: To authenticate users (e.g., via email magic link or a connected account) and manage accounts and subscriptions.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_HOW_WE_USE_ITEM_PAYMENTS: To process payments and prevent fraud (Stripe for subscriptions and gifts, PayPal for creator payouts).

LEGAL_PRIVACY_HOW_WE_USE_ITEM_PREVENT_AB: Para detectar, investigar y prevenir actividades abusivas o ilegales.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_HOW_WE_USE_ITEM_LEGAL: Para cumplir con las obligaciones legales y hacer cumplir nuestros Términos del servicio.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_THIRD_PARTIES_INTRO: Utilizamos proveedores de confianza para operar la Plataforma. Estos pueden incluir:
LEGAL_PRIVACY_PROCESSOR_CLOUDFLARE_TEXT: R2 object storage, Stream video encoding and delivery, CDN, DDoS protection, and related services.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_PROCESSOR_STRIPE_TEXT: Subscription and gift payments. Card details are entered on Stripe and never reach Snipp's servers.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_PROCESSOR_EMAIL_TEXT: Delivery of sign-in links and account, billing, and notification emails.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_PROCESSOR_OAUTH_TEXT: Discord, Google, GitHub, and X, used to authenticate you when you choose to sign in with a connected account.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_THIRD_PARTIES_NO_SALE: Estos proveedores tratan los datos en nuestro nombre y únicamente en la medida necesaria para prestar sus servicios. No vendemos su información personal.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_PROCESSOR_SUPABASE_TEXT: Managed database and authentication that store your account data.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_PROCESSOR_PAYPAL_TEXT: Creator payouts. We share only the PayPal email and amount needed to pay you; no card or bank numbers are stored by Snipp.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_PROCESSOR_OPENAI_TEXT: Automated content moderation. Uploaded media and text may be sent for safety classification.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_COOKIES_BODY: Snipp uses only strictly necessary, first-party cookies: a secure cookie to keep you signed in, a CSRF-protection token, a short-lived referral tag, and temporary sign-in state when you use a connected account. Your theme preference is stored the same way, and your cookie choice is saved locally in your browser. We do not use tracking, analytics, or advertising cookies.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_RETENTION_BODY: We keep your account information for as long as your account is active. You can delete individual uploads at any time, and you can permanently delete your account and its data from your settings. When you delete your account, we remove your profile, uploaded files, and associated social data such as comments, likes, and follows. Some records may be kept where required for legal, tax, security, or fraud-prevention purposes, such as transaction and payout history or records related to policy enforcement.

COMPARE_IMGUR_META_DESCRIPTION: Snipp vs Imgur: a private-by-default, ad-free alternative for hosting and sharing your screenshots and clips. See the full comparison.
COMPARE_IMGUR_INTRO: Looking for an Imgur alternative? Snipp hosts your images and clips with privacy by default and no ads, all from one link.
COMPARE_IMGUR_WHY_SNIPP_BODY: Snipp keeps every upload private by default, so only people with the link can see it, the opposite of Imgur's public-first model. There are no ads, no algorithmic feed pushing your uploads to strangers, and your screenshots and clips live under one account. You also get ShareX support and custom embeds, so your links look the way you want when shared. There is also an open API: Imgur no longer lets you generate your own API key, while any free Snipp account can create one and build on the official JavaScript, Python, and Rust SDKs.
COMPARE_IMGUR_WHY_THEM_BODY: Imgur has a huge public community and is great if your goal is reaching that audience or posting to its front page. If you want your image seen by as many strangers as possible, Imgur's reach is hard to beat. Snipp is built for the opposite: fast, private sharing with the people you choose.
COMPARE_FAQ_POSITIONING_IMGUR_Q: Is Snipp a good Imgur alternative?
COMPARE_FAQ_POSITIONING_IMGUR_A: Yes. Snipp covers the core of what most people use Imgur for, hosting an image and getting a link to share, while adding privacy by default, no ads, and clip hosting in the same place.
COMPARE_FAQ_PRIVATE_IMGUR_Q: Are my uploads private on Snipp?
COMPARE_FAQ_PRIVATE_IMGUR_A: Every upload is unlisted by default, so only someone with the link can open it. Imgur uploads are public-leaning by default. You can change visibility on Snipp at any time.
COMPARE_FAQ_FREE_IMGUR_A: Snipp has a free forever tier with a weekly upload allowance. Snipp+ raises the limits and adds custom embeds and more, but you never have to pay to share a screenshot or clip.
COMPARE_FAQ_API_IMGUR_Q: Can I still get an Imgur API key?
COMPARE_FAQ_API_IMGUR_A: No. Imgur has stopped issuing API keys, with no explanation and no timeline for bringing them back. The API itself still works and uploading to Imgur through ShareX is fine for anyone, but you cannot create a key of your own. Snipp's API is open to every account: create a key in Console on the free tier, with no application or approval step, and use the official JavaScript, Python, and Rust SDKs.
COMPARE_GYAZO_META_DESCRIPTION: Snipp vs Gyazo: host screenshots and clips together with privacy by default and a genuinely free tier. See the full comparison.
COMPARE_GYAZO_INTRO: Looking for a Gyazo alternative? Snipp captures the same instant-share workflow and adds clip hosting and a free forever tier.
COMPARE_GYAZO_WHY_SNIPP_BODY: Snipp gives you the instant screenshot-to-link flow Gyazo is known for, then goes further: your clips and videos live alongside your images under one account, uploads are private by default, and the free tier stays usable instead of pushing you to a subscription to keep your history. ShareX and custom embeds round it out.
COMPARE_GYAZO_WHY_THEM_BODY: Gyazo's desktop capture tool is polished and its GIF capture is well loved. If your whole workflow is built around Gyazo's capture app and you mostly share quick screenshots, it does that job well. Snipp is the better fit if you want screenshots and clips in one private home with a free tier that does not expire your uploads.
COMPARE_FAQ_POSITIONING_GYAZO_Q: Is Snipp a good Gyazo alternative?
COMPARE_FAQ_POSITIONING_GYAZO_A: Yes. Snipp matches the fast capture-and-share workflow and adds clip hosting, privacy by default, and a free tier that keeps your uploads.
COMPARE_FAQ_FREE_GYAZO_Q: Is Snipp's free tier better than Gyazo's?
COMPARE_FAQ_FREE_GYAZO_A: Snipp's free forever tier lets you upload and keep your screenshots and clips with a weekly allowance, without the time-limited history some Gyazo free plans apply.
COMPARE_FAQ_SCREENSHOTS_GYAZO_Q: Can I use Snipp just for screenshots?
COMPARE_FAQ_SCREENSHOTS_GYAZO_A: Absolutely. Snipp works great as a pure screenshot host, and clip hosting is there for free whenever you need it.
COMPARE_MEDAL_META_DESCRIPTION: Snipp vs Medal: one home for your clips and your screenshots, with instant links and privacy by default. See the full comparison.
COMPARE_MEDAL_INTRO: Looking for a Medal alternative? Snipp hosts your clips and your screenshots together, so you stop juggling two tools.
COMPARE_MEDAL_WHY_SNIPP_BODY: Medal is a clip capture and sharing platform. Snipp is a host for everything you share, clips and images alike, behind one link. If you currently use Medal for video and something else for screenshots, Snipp replaces both. Uploads are private by default, links are instant, and there is no public feed competing for your content.
COMPARE_MEDAL_WHY_THEM_BODY: Medal's in-game capture, clip editing, and gaming community are strong, and if recording gameplay highlights to a social feed is your main goal, that is what Medal is built for. Snipp is the better fit when you want one private place to host and link both clips and screenshots, rather than a capture-and-post social platform.
COMPARE_FAQ_POSITIONING_MEDAL_Q: Is Snipp a good Medal alternative?
COMPARE_FAQ_POSITIONING_MEDAL_A: Snipp is an alternative for the hosting and sharing side: it gives you instant links for clips and images together. It is not a game-capture recorder, so pair it with your capture tool of choice.
COMPARE_FAQ_IMAGES_MEDAL_Q: Does Snipp host images too, unlike Medal?
COMPARE_FAQ_IMAGES_MEDAL_A: Yes. That is the main difference. Snipp hosts your screenshots and your clips under one account, so you do not need a separate image host.
COMPARE_FAQ_LINK_MEDAL_Q: Do I get an instant link like Medal?
COMPARE_FAQ_LINK_MEDAL_A: Yes. Upload a clip or screenshot and you get a shareable link right away, with privacy controls so you decide who sees it.
COMPARE_STREAMABLE_META_DESCRIPTION: Snipp vs Streamable: host clips and screenshots together with a free forever tier and privacy by default. See the full comparison.
COMPARE_STREAMABLE_INTRO: Looking for a Streamable alternative? Snipp hosts your clips and your images together, with a free tier and instant links.
COMPARE_STREAMABLE_WHY_SNIPP_BODY: Streamable focuses on video. Snipp hosts your clips and your screenshots in one place, so a single account and a single link cover everything you share. Uploads are private by default, the free tier stays usable, and you get ShareX support and custom embeds that Streamable does not offer.
COMPARE_STREAMABLE_WHY_THEM_BODY: Streamable is a clean, video-only sharing service and handles longer videos well. If you only ever share video and want a service dedicated to that, it does the job. Snipp is the better fit when you want clips and images together, a free forever tier, and privacy by default.
COMPARE_FAQ_POSITIONING_STREAMABLE_Q: Is Snipp a good Streamable alternative?
COMPARE_FAQ_POSITIONING_STREAMABLE_A: Yes for sharing clips, and it does more: Snipp also hosts your screenshots and images, so you are not limited to video.
COMPARE_FAQ_FREE_STREAMABLE_A: Snipp has a free forever tier with a weekly allowance. Snipp+ raises limits and adds custom embeds, but sharing a clip never requires payment.
COMPARE_FAQ_IMAGES_STREAMABLE_Q: Can Snipp host images, not just video?
COMPARE_FAQ_IMAGES_STREAMABLE_A: Yes. Snipp hosts screenshots and images alongside your clips, which Streamable does not do.
COMPARE_IMGBB_META_DESCRIPTION: Snipp vs ImgBB: a private-by-default image and clip host with custom embeds and instant links. See the full comparison.
COMPARE_IMGBB_INTRO: Looking for an ImgBB alternative? Snipp hosts your images privately by default and adds clip hosting and custom embeds.
COMPARE_IMGBB_WHY_SNIPP_BODY: ImgBB is a straightforward image host. Snipp does that and more: uploads are private by default rather than public, you can host clips and video alongside images, and custom embeds let your links look polished when shared. ShareX support makes capturing and uploading effortless.
COMPARE_IMGBB_WHY_THEM_BODY: ImgBB is simple and quick for a one-off public image upload with no account needed. If that is all you want, it works. Snipp is the better fit when you want privacy by default, clip hosting, custom embeds, and an account that keeps your uploads organized.
COMPARE_FAQ_POSITIONING_IMGBB_Q: Is Snipp a good ImgBB alternative?
COMPARE_FAQ_POSITIONING_IMGBB_A: Yes. Snipp hosts images like ImgBB and adds privacy by default, clip hosting, and custom embeds.
COMPARE_FAQ_PRIVATE_IMGBB_A: Yes, every upload is unlisted by default so only people with the link can see it. You can change visibility whenever you want.
COMPARE_FAQ_CLIPS_IMGBB_Q: Can Snipp host clips, not just images?
COMPARE_FAQ_CLIPS_IMGBB_A: Yes. Snipp hosts your clips and videos alongside your screenshots, all under one account.

FOR_GAMERS_INTRO: Share your best plays, screenshots, and clips with one link. Built for gamers, free forever.
FOR_GAMERS_WHY_BODY: Gamers share constantly: a clutch clip, a funny screenshot, a new skin. Snipp gives you one home for all of it. Upload a clip or screenshot and get an instant link that unfurls beautifully in Discord. Videos stream in adaptive quality so your clips start playing right away, with no waiting for a download. FOR_FAQ_CLIPS_GAMERS_Q: Can I host game clips on Snipp?
FOR_FAQ_CLIPS_GAMERS_A: Yes. Snipp hosts your video clips with adaptive streaming so they play instantly, and gives you a link to share anywhere, including Discord.

FOR_DEVELOPERS_META_DESCRIPTION: Snipp is built for developers: API access, ShareX support, direct file links, and custom embeds. Private by default, with no ads.
FOR_DEVELOPERS_HERO: Image and file hosting built for developers
FOR_DEVELOPERS_INTRO: Upload via API or ShareX, get direct links, and keep it private by default. Built for developers.
FOR_DEVELOPERS_WHY_BODY: Developers want a host that gets out of the way. Snipp gives you a simple API with your own key so you can upload programmatically, plus first-class ShareX support so a screenshot becomes a link with one keystroke. FOR_FAQ_LINKS_DEVELOPERS_Q: Do I get a direct link to the file?
FOR_FAQ_LINKS_DEVELOPERS_A: Yes. Snipp gives you a direct link to the raw file, which is ideal for embedding, hotlinking, and use in your own projects.

FOR_STREAMERS_HERO: Clip and highlight hosting built for streamers
FOR_STREAMERS_INTRO: Host your highlights and clips, share them with your community in one link. Built for streamers.

FOR_FAQ_DISCORD_STREAMERS_Q: Will my clips embed in my Discord server?
FOR_FAQ_DISCORD_STREAMERS_A: Yes. Snipp links unfurl into rich embeds in Discord, so your community can watch your highlights inline without leaving the server.
FOR_FAQ_FREE_STREAMERS_A: Yes. Snipp has a free forever tier. Snipp+ adds higher limits and more priority streaming minutes, but sharing a clip is always free.
FOR_CREATORS_META_DESCRIPTION: Snipp is built for creators: host your screenshots and clips with no watermark, custom embeds, and instant links. Free, with no ads.
FOR_CREATORS_INTRO: Host your screenshots and clips with no watermark and no ads. Built for creators.

Get an instant link to share on any platform, customize how it embeds with your own titles and colors, and keep drafts private by default until you are ready. FOR_FAQ_FREE_CREATORS_A: Yes. Snipp has a free forever tier with a weekly allowance. Snipp+ raises the limits and adds custom embeds and more.

FOR_DESIGNERS_HERO: Screenshot and mockup sharing built for designers

SUPPORT_SECURITY_META_DESCRIPTION: Reporta vulnerabilidades de seguridad a Snipp de forma responsable. Consulta las directrices del bug bounty, el alcance, las recompensas y las expectativas de divulgación.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_INTRO_P1: Security is core to keeping Snipp safe for everyone, and we rely on researchers to help us find and fix vulnerabilities quickly. If you've discovered a security issue, we want to know about it. We appreciate every responsible disclosure, happy hunting!
SUPPORT_SECURITY_COMMITMENT_P1: Nunca emprenderemos acciones legales contra quienes reporten vulnerabilidades de buena fe y sigan las directrices de esta página.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_COMMITMENT_P2: Nuestro objetivo es confirmar cada reporte en un plazo de 48 horas y te mantendremos informado durante todo el proceso de resolución.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_COMMITMENT_P3: Según la gravedad y el impacto de tu hallazgo, podrías ser elegible para una insignia de perfil exclusiva y meses gratuitos de nuestra suscripción PLUS.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_BADGES_P1: Los investigadores que hagan contribuciones significativas a la seguridad de Snipp pueden ganar insignias de perfil que se muestran públicamente en su cuenta.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_BADGES_BUG_HUNTER: Awarded for your first valid vulnerability report. Recognizes researchers who help make Snipp safer.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_BADGES_ELITE_BUG_HUNTER: Awarded after 3-5 exceptional reports or a single critical finding. Reserved for active researchers who uncover the most impactful issues.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_GUIDELINES_ITEM_OWN_ACC: Todas las pruebas deben realizarse en tus propias cuentas. Nunca interactúes con los datos o las cuentas de otros usuarios ni los afectes.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_GUIDELINES_ITEM_SNIPP_O: Solo los servicios operados por Snipp están dentro del alcance. No se aceptarán informes dirigidos a plataformas de terceros, incluso aquellas integradas a través de nuestra API.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_GUIDELINES_ITEM_NO_SERV: Avoid any activity that could degrade our services or compromise data integrity. This includes brute forcing, DoS, spamming, and timing-based attacks.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_GUIDELINES_ITEM_NO_AUTO: No se permiten herramientas de escaneo automatizadas. Todas las pruebas deben realizarse manualmente.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_GUIDELINES_ITEM_TEMP_SC: Es posible que excluyamos temporalmente ciertas clases de vulnerabilidades del alcance mientras las abordamos internamente. Cualquier cambio se reflejará en esta página.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_GUIDELINES_ITEM_KEEP_CO: Por favor, mantén todos los hallazgos confidenciales hasta que hayamos investigado y resuelto el problema por completo.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_HANDLING_P1: La divulgación responsable es la mejor manera de ayudarnos a solucionar los problemas rápidamente minimizando el riesgo. Cuando nos lo reportas directamente, podemos empezar a trabajar en una solución de inmediato sin exponer la vulnerabilidad a actores maliciosos.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_HANDLING_P2: Findings that are shared publicly before we've had a chance to address them, whether on social media, forums, or anywhere else, will not be eligible for badge recognition. We want to credit the people who give us the opportunity to fix things first.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_HANDLING_IMPACT_REQUIRE: A report must demonstrate real-world impact. A CVSS score on its own, without a working proof of concept showing what an attacker actually gains, is treated as informational and is not eligible for a reward.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_HANDLING_DUPLICATES_INT: Si varias personas reportan el mismo problema, evaluaremos los envíos según:
SUPPORT_SECURITY_HANDLING_DUPLICATES_ITE: Qué tan bien el informe transmite el impacto en el mundo real
SUPPORT_SECURITY_HANDLING_P3: Apreciamos sinceramente a cada investigador que dedica su tiempo a ayudar a hacer Snipp más seguro.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_PUBLIC_DATA_INTRO: Some data is public on purpose. Information that already appears on public pages is not confidential, and reading it, whether through the site, an API endpoint, or while logged out, is not a vulnerability. Before reporting a data exposure, check whether the same data is already shown publicly. The following are public by design:
SUPPORT_SECURITY_PUBLIC_DATA_ITEM_PROFIL: Profile information shown on a user's public page: username, display name, avatar, banner, bio, linked socials, join date, and follower and following counts.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_PUBLIC_DATA_ITEM_BADGES: Profile badges and the status behind them, including staff, partner, bug hunter, translator, verified, and supporter. These are displayed publicly as badges.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_PUBLIC_DATA_ITEM_POSTS: Post information on a public or unlisted post: title, description, media, view count, and upload date.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_PUBLIC_DATA_ITEM_VIEWER: Viewer-relative flags that only reflect your own session, such as whether a profile is your own, whether you follow a user, or whether a block exists between you and them. These describe your relationship to the data, not anyone else's private information.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_INTRO: Antes de enviar, piensa si el problema tiene un escenario de ataque realista y un impacto de seguridad significativo. Lo siguiente queda generalmente excluido:
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_PUBLI: Disclosure of data that is already public by design (see the section above), including profile fields, badges, post metadata, and viewer-relative flags
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_CLIEN: Reports based on client-side validation alone. Security checks are enforced on the server, so a missing client-side check is not a vulnerability when the server rejects the same input
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_UPLOA: File type, MIME, or extension handling on uploads. Uploaded files are validated by their actual content on the server, and the stored type is never taken from the client
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_ORIGI: Disclosure of an origin IP address, infrastructure provider, or unproxied subdomain. Some services, such as upload endpoints, are intentionally served outside the CDN and are hardened at the origin
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_STALE: Stale or historical DNS records that no longer point to live infrastructure
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_MISSI: Missing or misconfigured security headers, such as CSP, HSTS, or X-Frame-Options, without a demonstrated working exploit
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_VERBO: Verbose error messages, stack traces, or software version disclosure without a demonstrated working exploit
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_RESOU: Enumeration of valid resources by identifier, or 4xx and 5xx responses to invalid identifiers. Returning a not-found status to an invalid request is expected behavior
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_MITM_: Ataques que requieren MITM o acceso físico al dispositivo de un usuario
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_CONTE: Suplantación de contenido e inyección de texto
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_EMAIL: Registros SPF, DKIM y DMARC del correo electrónico
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_COOKI: Falta de los indicadores de cookie HttpOnly/Secure
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_SCANN: Informes de escáneres y herramientas automatizadas
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_SELF_: Autoexplotación (como la reutilización de tokens y los scripts de consola)
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_SOCIA: Ataques de ingeniería social o phishing dirigidos a usuarios o personal
SUPPORT_SECURITY_NOTES_THIRD_PARTY_BODY: Los servicios externos, los socios y las integraciones quedan fuera del alcance de este programa. Solo se admiten vulnerabilidades en las funciones y API propiedad de Snipp. Los informes deben mostrar un impacto de seguridad claro para Snipp.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_NOTES_TOKEN_THEFT_BODY: Cualquier escenario en el que un atacante pueda obtener las claves de API, los tokens de sesión o las credenciales de otro usuario sin recurrir a la ingeniería social se considera dentro del alcance.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_NOTES_CRASHES_BODY: Los fallos reproducibles del sitio web causados por entradas manipuladas o por la interacción normal del usuario se consideran dentro del alcance, siempre que no dependan del agotamiento de recursos, el spam u otras técnicas de denegación de servicio.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_NOTES_RACE_CONDITIONS_I: Los informes que dependen de explotar una condición de carrera necesitan pruebas adicionales para ser aceptados. Incluye al menos uno de los siguientes elementos:
Un script reproducible (preferiblemente Python o JavaScript, aunque otros lenguajes están bien)
Una explicación detallada que cubra los métodos HTTP, los endpoints y el orden exacto de las solicitudes necesario para desencadenar la condición
SUPPORT_SECURITY_NOTES_RACE_CONDITIONS_P: Incluir un script nos facilita mucho verificar el problema y agiliza el proceso de revisión.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_CTA_BODY: Envíanos un correo electrónico con una descripción clara del problema, los pasos para reproducirlo y cualquier prueba de apoyo. Te responderemos lo antes posible.

SUPPORT_BADGES_INTRO_P1: Badges are small icons shown next to your name across Snipp. Some recognize what you've contributed, others reflect your account status. Here's every badge, what it means, and how to get it.
SUPPORT_BADGES_VERIFIED_BODY: The Verified badge marks notable accounts and confirms an identity is genuine. It is granted by the Snipp team, typically to public figures, brands, and creators with an established presence. It cannot be requested directly, though an active and authentic profile helps.
SUPPORT_BADGES_SUBSCRIBER_BODY: The Subscriber badge shows you support Snipp with an active PLUS subscription. It appears for as long as your subscription is active. Upgrade on the pricing page to earn it. Hover the badge to see when you subscribed.
SUPPORT_BADGES_BUG_HUNTER_BODY: The Bug Hunter badge is awarded for your first valid security report through our bug bounty program. It recognizes researchers who responsibly disclose vulnerabilities and help keep Snipp safe.
SUPPORT_BADGES_ELITE_BUG_HUNTER_BODY: The Elite Bug Hunter badge is reserved for our most impactful researchers. It is awarded after 3-5 exceptional reports or a single critical finding, and replaces the Bug Hunter badge once earned.
SUPPORT_BADGES_TRANSLATOR_BODY: The Translator badge is awarded for meaningful contributions to Snipp's translations. Help translate the app into your language to earn it, along with the Translator role in our Discord server.
SUPPORT_BADGES_EARLY_SUPPORTER_BODY: The Early Supporter badge is a permanent thank-you for everyone who joined Snipp in its first months. It was granted automatically to accounts created during the launch window and can no longer be earned.
SUPPORT_BADGES_PARTNER_BODY: The Partner badge marks creators and communities in an official partnership with Snipp. It is granted by the Snipp team as part of a partnership agreement and cannot be requested directly.
SUPPORT_BADGES_STAFF_BODY: The Snipp Staff badge identifies members of the Snipp team. It helps you recognize official accounts when receiving support, and cannot be earned. Staff have no access to your account or gallery, and will never ask you for your password or login codes.
SUPPORT_BADGES_DISPLAY_BODY: Badges show automatically next to your name on your profile and wherever your account appears across Snipp, including profile popouts. There is nothing to enable, a badge appears as soon as you earn it. Badges cannot be hidden or removed on request.
SUPPORT_BADGES_CTA_BODY: Have a question about a badge or think one is missing from your profile? Reach out and we'll be happy to help.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_META_DESCRIPTION: Help translate Snipp into your language. Learn how the translation files work, the rules to follow, and how to submit your changes.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_INTRO_P1: Snipp is translated by its community, and we'd love your help. If you're fluent in another language, you can improve existing translations or help bring Snipp to a new one. This guide covers everything you need.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_REWARDS_ITEM_BADGE: Meaningful contributions earn you the exclusive Translator badge on your Snipp profile.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_REWARDS_ITEM_ROLE: You'll also receive the Translator role in our Discord server.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_REWARDS_ITEM_PLUS: Heavy contributors may receive Snipp PLUS as a thank-you.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_GETTING_STARTED_P1_B: The best place to start is our
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_GETTING_STARTED_P1_A: where translators coordinate, claim languages, and get help. Let us know which language you'd like to work on so efforts aren't duplicated.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_WAYS_INTRO: There are two ways to contribute translations. Pick whichever suits you, you don't need to use both.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_WAYS_CROWDIN_BODY: The easiest option. Translate directly in your browser with no JSON or Git knowledge required. Crowdin shows each string in context and handles formatting for you. Recommended for most translators.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_WAYS_GITHUB_BODY: For developers comfortable with Git. Edit the locale JSON files directly and open a pull request. Best if you want full control or are adding a new language.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_FILES_P1: Every locale is a flat JSON file. The key is a stable ID and never changes. The value is the text shown to users, and that's the only thing you translate:
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_FILES_P2: The English file is the source of truth. Every other locale has the exact same set of keys, so you only ever change the values.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_RULES_ITEM_VALUES_ON: Never add, remove, or rename keys. New keys come from the Snipp codebase. If a key is missing in your locale, the site falls back to English.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_RULES_ITEM_PLACEHOLD: Keep placeholders identical. Text like {count} or {username} is replaced at runtime. Keep the exact same placeholders, though you may move them to fit your language's word order.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_RULES_ITEM_CASING: Match the casing convention. Short UI labels use Title Case in every language. Full sentences use normal sentence case for your language.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_RULES_ITEM_BRAND_TOK: Don't translate brand or technical tokens. Leave Snipp, Discord, ShareX, URL, API, PLUS, and file extensions as-is.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_RULES_ITEM_VALID_JSO: Keep it valid JSON. Use double quotes, a comma after every entry except the last, and no trailing commas.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_RULES_ITEM_SPACING: Preserve leading and trailing spaces if a value has them. They are intentional and used for joining sentences.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_SUBMITTING_P0: If you chose the GitHub path, here's the flow. Crowdin translators can skip this section, your changes are submitted from within Crowdin.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_SUBMITTING_STEP_FORK: Fork the repository, then clone your fork and create a new branch for your change.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_SUBMITTING_STEP_EDIT: Edit the locale file for your language and translate the values you want to improve.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_SUBMITTING_STEP_VALI: Run the validation script from the repo root and fix anything it reports before submitting.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_SUBMITTING_STEP_PR: Commit, push to your fork, and open a pull request against the main branch. A maintainer reviews and merges it.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_SUBMITTING_P2: Prefer not to use the command line? GitHub's web editor works too. Open the locale file, click the pencil icon, edit, and propose your changes.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_NEW_LANGUAGE_BODY: Snipp doesn't support your language yet? Open an issue on GitHub proposing the language and its locale code, copy the English source file as a starting point, translate every value, and open a pull request. A maintainer registers the new locale on the site.
SUPPORT_TRANSLATING_CTA_BODY: Join our Discord server to claim a language, meet other translators, and get started.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_META_DESCRIPTION: How Snipp gifts work, how to claim a gift link, and how to redeem a gift code for Snipp+ or Ultra.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_INTRO_P1: A Snipp gift gives you a subscription for a set amount of time. If someone has sent you a gift, or you've received a gift code, this guide walks you through claiming and redeeming it.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_WHAT_ITEM_TIERS: Gifts unlock a subscription tier, either Snipp+ or Ultra, with all the perks of that tier.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_WHAT_ITEM_DURATION: Every gift lasts for a set period, measured in days, months, or years. The duration is shown to you before you accept.

SUPPORT_GIFTING_WHAT_ITEM_SOURCE_AFTER_L: . Buying one gives you a code to share with anyone.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_CLAIM_LINK_P1: Most gifts arrive as a link. Opening it takes you to a claim page that checks the gift and shows you what it unlocks:
SUPPORT_GIFTING_CLAIM_LINK_ITEM_OPEN: Open the gift link. Snipp verifies the code and shows the tier and duration.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_CLAIM_LINK_ITEM_LOGIN: If you're not logged in, you'll be asked to log in or create a Snipp account first. You'll return to the claim page afterwards.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_CLAIM_LINK_ITEM_ACCEPT: Press Accept to apply the gift to your account.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_LEGIT_DOMAINS_HEADING: Check the Link Before You Click
SUPPORT_GIFTING_LEGIT_DOMAINS_BODY: Official Snipp gift links only ever come from two domains: snipp.gift and snipp.gg/gift. Most gifts use snipp.gift. A gift link on any other domain is not legitimate, never log in or enter your details there. When in doubt, redeem the code manually on the Redeem page instead.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_REDEEM_P1_BEFORE_LINK: If you have a gift code on its own rather than a link, you can enter it on the
SUPPORT_GIFTING_REDEEM_P1_AFTER_LINK: in your account settings. Paste the code, redeem it, and the gift is applied right away.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_ACCEPT_ITEM_APPLIED: The subscription is added to your account immediately, no payment details required.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_ACCEPT_ITEM_EXPIRY: Your gift has an expiry date. You can see exactly when it ends on your billing page at any time.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_ACCEPT_ITEM_STACKING: A gift for the tier you already have extends it. A gift for a higher tier upgrades you straight away and keeps the time you had. A gift for a lower tier is saved as credit and starts when your current plan ends.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_ISSUES_INTRO: If a gift won't redeem, one of these is usually the reason:
SUPPORT_GIFTING_ISSUES_ITEM_INVALID: Invalid code: the code is mistyped or doesn't exist. Check it was copied in full.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_ISSUES_ITEM_EXPIRED: Expired code: the gift was not redeemed before its expiry date and can no longer be used.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_ISSUES_ITEM_EXHAUSTED: Fully redeemed: the code has already been used the maximum number of times.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_ISSUES_ITEM_ALREADY_REDE: Already redeemed: you've already claimed this code on your account.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_ISSUES_ITEM_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Not eligible: your account is too new. Some gifts require your account to reach a minimum age before they can be redeemed.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_ISSUES_ITEM_PERMANENT: Nothing to extend: your plan has no expiry date, so a gift has nothing to add to. Your code is not used up, so you can pass it to someone else.
SUPPORT_GIFTING_CTA_BODY: Head to the Redeem page to apply your code, or reach out to support if a gift isn't working.

SUPPORT_PAYOUTS_WHAT_COUNTS_ITEM_PLUS: Referred friends who subscribe to Snipp+ earn you a bonus.

SUPPORT_PAYOUTS_POOL_ITEM_SHARED: Payouts come from a shared creator pool, split between selected creators based on the people they refer. It's about how many you bring relative to other creators, not a fixed rate.
SUPPORT_PAYOUTS_POOL_ITEM_GROWS: The pool will grow as Snipp+ grows, so referring people who subscribe helps everyone.
SUPPORT_PAYOUTS_POOL_ITEM_ENGAGEMENT: The more people you refer, the bigger your share.
SUPPORT_PAYOUTS_WHEN_ITEM_BIWEEKLY: Payouts are calculated every two weeks and sent shortly after each period ends.
SUPPORT_PAYOUTS_WHEN_ITEM_MINIMUM: There's a minimum payout amount each period. If you're under it, your balance rolls over and adds to your next payout.
SUPPORT_PAYOUTS_WHEN_P1_BEFORE_LINK: You can track your estimated payout anytime in your
SUPPORT_PAYOUTS_WHEN_ITEM_EMAIL: Payouts are sent straight to your PayPal, so add your PayPal email in your analytics dashboard to get paid. You'll get an email confirming each one.

SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_META_DESCRIPTION: How Snipp's weekly upload quota works, what counts toward it, and the limits for Free, PLUS, and Ultra accounts.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_INTRO_P1: Snipp caps how much you can upload each week. This keeps service fast for everyone and prevents abuse, while still leaving plenty of room for normal use.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_PLAN_QUOTAS_ITEM_F: 2 GB total uploads per week, with a 50 MB cap per file.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_PLAN_QUOTAS_ITEM_P: 20 GB per week, no per-file cap. That's 10x the free weekly allowance, and a single upload can fill the whole quota.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_PLAN_QUOTAS_ITEM_U: 50 GB per week, no per-file cap.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_RESET_SCHEDULE_ITE: Your account has a fixed reset day and time, assigned when you sign up. It stays the same every week, whether or not you upload anything.
At that moment each week your entire quota returns to zero. Unused allowance does not carry over.
Example: if your reset lands on Sunday at 3:30 PM, your full quota is restored every Sunday at 3:30 PM, no matter when during the week you used it.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_WHAT_COUNTS_ITEM_A: Cada subida exitosa cuenta: sitio web, API, ShareX y XerahS. Las publicaciones públicas, no listadas y privadas cuentan por igual.
Los álbumes cuentan como la suma de sus archivos. Un álbum de 5 archivos de 200 MB cada uno usa 1 GB de cuota.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_WHAT_COUNTS_ITEM_F: Uploads that fail before they finish, such as a rate-limited or interrupted request, do not consume quota. Once an upload is stored the bytes are spent, even if the post is later moderated.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_WHAT_COUNTS_ITEM_D: Deleting a post does not refund its quota. Bytes only come back at your weekly reset, never by deleting.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_HITTING_LIMIT_ITEM: When you're out of quota, new uploads return a "Weekly usage limit exceeded" error with the timestamp of your next reset.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_HITTING_LIMIT_P1_B: Consulta tu uso en tiempo real y la cuenta atrás hasta tu próxima recarga desde los
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_HITTING_LIMIT_P2_A: aplica tu cuota más alta de inmediato, incluido el uso que ya has acumulado.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_CTA_BODY: ¿Tienes un proyecto que necesita más de 50 GB por semana? Contáctanos y elaboraremos un plan que se ajuste a tus necesidades.
SUPPORT_PRIORITY_MINUTES_META_DESCRIPTIO: How Snipp's priority minutes work, the monthly streaming budget for Free, PLUS, and Ultra accounts, and what happens when you run out.
SUPPORT_PRIORITY_MINUTES_INTRO_P1: Videos on Snipp can stream through adaptive bitrate for fast seeking and multiple quality levels. Every account gets a monthly budget of priority minutes that route video to streaming, while everything keeps working once the budget is spent.
SUPPORT_PRIORITY_MINUTES_PLAN_ALLOWANCES: 10 minutes per month, with faster seeking and multiple quality levels.
100 minutes per month, with faster seeking and multiple quality levels on more of your videos.
300 minutes per month, with faster seeking and multiple quality levels on nearly everything you upload.
SUPPORT_PRIORITY_MINUTES_RESET_SCHEDULE_: Your account has a fixed reset date and time, assigned when you sign up. It comes around every 30 days, whether or not you stream anything.
At that moment your entire budget returns to zero. Unused minutes do not carry over.
Example: if your reset lands on the 3rd at 9:00 AM, all of your priority minutes are restored every 30 days at that same time.
SUPPORT_PRIORITY_MINUTES_WHAT_USES_ITEM_: Only videos count. Images, screenshots, and other files never use priority minutes.
A video's duration is what's measured, not its file size. A short clip uses few minutes regardless of how large the file is.
A per-video length cap also applies: 60 minutes per video. Videos longer than the cap always play in standard quality, no matter how much budget you have left.
SUPPORT_PRIORITY_MINUTES_RUNNING_OUT_ITE: Nothing breaks. Videos still upload and play, just in standard quality served straight from storage without adaptive bitrate. It's a graceful fallback, not a block.
